name.ja: BB戦士383 LEGENDBB ストライク劉備ガンダム
name.en: BB Senshi 383 LEGENDBB Strike Liu Bei Gundam

description.ja: • 神器との組み合わせで三形態を再現。さらに全装備も可能。
description.en: • Reproduce the three forms in combination with the sacred treasure. Furthermore, full equipment is also available.

description.ja: • 差し替えパーツで表情４種類を再現可能。
description.en: • Four types of facial expressions can be reproduced with replacement parts.

description.ja: • 龍頭角飾りは金メッキ仕様。
description.en: • The dragon head and horn decoration is gold-plated.

description.ja: • 背部ラックに鋼龍刀を収納できる。腰にも帯刀可能。
description.en: • You can store the Steel Dragon Sword in the back rack. The sword can also be worn on the waist.
